definitions.explanation: The complete thing considered as a unit.
Used adverbially to mean 'in general' or 'overall'.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}を{見|み}て{判断|はんだん}すべきだ。
examples.english: You should judge by looking at the whole picture.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{全体|ぜんたい}で{取|と}り{組|く}む。
examples.english: The whole company will work on it together.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}{的|てき}に{良|よ}い{結果|けっか}だった。
examples.english: Overall, it was a good result.

notes:
{全体|ぜんたい} can be used as a noun or adverbially.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}{的|てき}に (overall, generally)
- {全体|ぜんたい}{像|ぞう} (overall picture)
- {全体|ぜんたい}{会議|かいぎ} (general meeting)
- ～{全体|ぜんたい} (the whole ~, all of ~)
- {社会|しゃかい}{全体|ぜんたい} (society as a whole)

EXPRESSION:
{一体|いったい}{全体|ぜんたい} - used for emphasis in questions ("just what/who/why on earth...")
